part: main loop: Condition and direction, students
question: Does local Clef accept the one-pass request (144 questions, then the dial details with a Score) and how closely do its answers match hosted Jev's?
one_change: send the same one-pass requests to local Clef for 10 engine stories

baseline.model: hosted Jev re-reading the same stories (T135-F3 repeat check), mean absolute difference of the noul answers

prediction.metric: mean absolute difference between Clef's and Jev's noul answers on the same request
prediction.why: Jev re-reads itself within 0.0047 (runs/pulse/t135/t135_full_read.json); two different models agree on presence only 0.775 (runs/pulse/t130/t130_jev_engine.json), so a clear gap is expected; pass tests written before the run: the whole 144-question request is accepted by Clef, else I record the batch size it needs; Score type accepted; noul answers within 0.2 of Jev's on at least 0.70 of the pairs; choice answers equal on at least 0.60; no hosted call, local GPU, about 10 stories, a few minutes; needs the owner's yes for the local GPU (D32 and D33 covered other cards)
